title: Is your Supabase app readable by anyone?
description: If your app runs on Supabase, there is a key sitting in your frontend code right now. Anyone who opens your site can find it in a few seconds. That part is fine. Supabase designed it that way. What is not fine is what that key can do if one setting is off, and in a lot of AI-built apps I look at, it is off ... welp! hold your cocktails folks, this is going to be wild.
